intent: Upgrade the Foshan viewer into Stage 2: a map-first digital-city core with fast 2D/3D switching, faithful road/water geography, GPU city buildings and a dedicated high-detail landmark layer.
constraints: Default map usage requires no paid API key.
The existing v1 Three.js viewer remains available as a legacy regression path.
Ordinary city buildings must no longer be generated via per-building Three.js ExtrudeGeometry in the Stage 2 entrypoint.
Road and water geometry must come from real open vector data, not hand-authored approximations.
Landmark assets bundled by the project must be project-owned or have verified redistribution rights and must state their fidelity class.
WGS84/Web Mercator is the common geographic reference for Stage 2 layers.
Reference reconstructions must not be represented as surveyed or photogrammetric truth.
nonGoals: Pixel-copying Google Maps, Amap, or their proprietary visual styles.
Claiming reference-reconstruction landmarks are finished photogrammetry assets.
Replacing surveyed photogrammetry where no open or licensed source exists.

requirements.statement: The default entrypoint uses MapLibre GL JS and supports interactive 2D and 3D modes in the same geographic camera.
Stage 2 ordinary buildings are rendered with vector-tile fill/fill-extrusion and not with per-building Three.js ExtrudeGeometry.
The 2D map renders real Overture road and water geometry and open labels; 3D mode retains the same geographic layout.
Overture buildings and Terrarium DEM are layered on the map for 3D buildings and terrain, and the production 3D browser proves buildings are visible.
A MapLibre custom layer backed by Three.js loads project-owned reference reconstructions and remains extensible to licensed GLB assets.
At least twelve Foshan landmark targets are exposed; at least five ship as detailed reference reconstructions and unfinished targets remain explicitly planned.
The v1 Three.js application remains buildable and accessible at legacy.html.
MapLibre v6 uses a Vite-bundled worker so production vector sources cannot silently fail while raster still renders.
Each delivered reference landmark has automated triangle-count, physical-scale and draw-call batch regression evidence and an explicit reference-reconstruction fidelity label.

checks.description: Static, legacy regression, Stage 2 architecture and landmark geometry checks pass.
Overture buildings/base/transportation, Terrarium and imagery are reachable and real Foshan road/water vectors decode.
Production 2D Chrome smoke reaches appReady=true with MapLibre worker configured, real road features > 0, real water features > 0 and five landmark models loaded.
Production 3D Chrome smoke reaches mapMode=3d with Overture buildings visibly rendered and five landmark models loaded; screenshot evidence is retained.
